body.title: Closing: constraints scored, crosswalk, deferred amendments and the live hand check
body.summary: Score the Epic constraints k1-k5 against the finished change in the BUILD summary; carry the c-id crosswalk (c3 and c12 to read:current-behaviour, c11 to read:queue-surface); list the deferred HLD additions for the Epic-end batch, including that S005 dropped the HLD's cross-repository keep set and session-store keep predicate by owner decision; run the live hand check (send a decision from the review pane while a turn runs and with the chat panel closed; disable the queue and confirm the chat is not offered), or record it as not run with the reason and the labelled fault-injection evidence.
acceptanceChecks: the BUILD summary scores k1-k5, lists the deferred HLD additions and carries the crosswalk
the hand check is recorded as a reported live test with its evidence, or as not run with the reason and labelled evidence

tests.name: hand check: a review-pane decision sent while a turn runs waits in the outbox and runs after it; with the chat panel closed it opens the chat and runs; with the queue unavailable the chat is not offered
